summary.text: Carrie Sanders McKeehan is the Republican candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 38 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Rachel Roarx (D).
An educator who was born and raised in Louisville, she has run for the House in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: McKeehan said in a Ballotpedia survey that she was born and raised in Louisville, works as an educator in the public and private sectors, and earlier had a career in social services serving families and child care facilities.
She said she holds an educational specialist degree, a master's degree in special education and a bachelor's degree in liberal studies.
McKeehan won the 2022 Republican primary for Kentucky House District 41 and lost that November's general election to incumbent Josie Raymond, receiving 26.5% of the vote.
She was also a candidate for District 38 in the 2024 general election.
In the survey she listed safety, school accountability, better jobs and limited government as concerns, and said she supports school choice.
She named opposition to abortion, quality schools, limited government and local businesses as policy interests.
